The '''Jatoon Sach'a''', or the '''Deep Swamp''', was a large murky area in the southern hemisphere of the swamp [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]. It was believed to be the home of the legendary [[Noga Mak'tu]], a giant [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] rumored to be ten times the size of the largest dianoga ever seen.
